mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in CPI inflation above 3.5% signals a 'higher for longer' monetary policy stance, increasing real yields and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS monthly change < 0 and CPIAUCSL monthly change > 3.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market tightening regime (UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 100k), strong employment dynamics support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market tightening (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 100k, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales volume (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS monthly change is positive, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market expansion (HOUST above 1300.0 thousand units), increased residential construction activity boosts related sectors and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1300.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100k indicates a tight labor market, increasing wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
